pages.text: The $(item)Blaze Burner$() is the closest thing this pack has to a universal heater. Many mods read Create's heat, and Create reads heat from other mods.$(br2)Basics: $(l:create_basics/heat)Blaze Burner and Heat$(/l).

$(bold)Cooking:$() with Central Kitchen, a Blaze Burner heats a Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot or Skillet, and a Farmer's Delight Stove counts as a passive heater under a Create boiler.$(br2)See $(l:food/kitchen_automation)Kitchen Automation$(/l).
$(bold)Boilers:$() besides the burner, Create's boiler accepts passive heat from the Stove, Twilight Forest's fiery storage blocks, lava, magma, campfires and fire. Weaker, but free.

$(bold)Your body:$() with Create: Cold Sweat, lit burners, steam engines, fans and hot tanks warm nearby players. A factory doubles as a heater in winter or high up.$(br2)See $(l:survival/temperature_create)Create and Altitude Heat$(/l).

$(bold)Flight:$() burners lift hot air balloons on Aeronautics ships, and they also keep the crew warm against altitude cold.$(br2)$(bold)Power:$() Create Propulsion's Stirling Engine turns heat below it into rotation.

$(bold)Water:$() Thirst Was Reclaimed purifies water by boiling in a campfire or furnace.$(br2)$(bold)The cost:$() a lit burner is one of the biggest smog sources. Put a Flue on top. See $(l:survival/pollution)Pollution$(/l).
